decisions.reason: The height-adjustable executive desk builds on the firm's office expertise, and post-pandemic demand for flexible workplace furniture likely keeps results near aspiration, so there is no trigger for problemistic search.
A chair family close to the core offer uses existing capabilities and is a long-lived category in premium furniture, so results are likely adequate and retention is cheap.
Floor cushions are a niche accessory whose results are uncertain, but the firm is hiring and runs its own R&D, which suggests enough slack to carry it a while longer.
The designer sofa by EOOS was actively promoted in 2019 and sits at the firm's residential core, so it likely meets aspiration levels.
The high standing table complements the conference and office range at low incremental cost, so there is little pressure to drop it.
The rug collection is distant from core competencies and likely falls short of aspiration in a flat market, which makes it the prime candidate for redirecting resources to the core business.
